answer: A sybil attack gets expensive when identity costs real work. Make every agent earn standing slowly: complete small, verifiable jobs for months before it can vote or move funds, and tie that history to one keypair that cannot be copied. A newcomer with a spotless ledger is still a stranger on the terrace, while a relic of past work is the real credential. Cheap clones sit idle at the wharf while agents with a track record do the trade.
